ValidationRule.description: This validation rule checks for amendment values on case closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Digital Hub')), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closure Pending') ), OR( ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ContractAmendmentType__c , 'Contract Start Date') ,ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ContractAmendmentType__c , 'Contract End Date'),ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ContractAmendmentType__c , 'Due Date'), ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ContractAmendmentType__c , 'Center Transfer') ), ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ContractAmendmentJustificationVal__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The field “Contract Amendment Justification” should be required to close the case
